00067 void LLineUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00068 {   
00069     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00070     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00071     
00072     if(increment > 0.f) {
00073         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00074         {
00075             // perhaps the increment should happen after the first sample output?
00076             // this is they way I'm going to do the Linen class below
00077             //currentValue += increment;
00078             
00079             if(currentValue >= end_) {
00080                 *outputSamples++ = end_;
00081                 while(numSamplesToProcess--)  {
00082                     *outputSamples++ = end_;
00083                 }
00084                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00085                 break;
00086             }
00087             else
00088             {
00089                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00090                 currentValue += increment;
00091             }
00092         }
00093     } else {
00094         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00095         {
00096             //currentValue += increment;
00097             
00098             if(currentValue <= end_) {
00099                 *outputSamples++ = end_;
00100                 while(numSamplesToProcess--)  {
00101                     *outputSamples++ = end_;
00102                 }
00103                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00104                 break;
00105             }
00106             else
00107             {
00108                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00109                 currentValue += increment;
00110             }
00111         }
00112     }
00113 }

00121 void LLineUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00122 {   
00123     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00124     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00125     const double krIncrement = increment * krBlockSize;
00126     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00127     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00128     
00129     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00130     
00131     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00132     {
00133         float nextValue = currentValue;
00134         
00135         if(numKrSamples == 0 && nextValue != end_)
00136         {
00137             nextValue += krIncrement;
00138             
00139             if((increment > 0.0 && nextValue >= end_) || 
00140                (increment < 0.0 && nextValue <= end_))
00141             {
00142                 nextValue = end_;
00143                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00144             }
00145         }
00146         
00147         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00148         blockPosition += numKrSamples;
00149         
00150         
00151         if(nextValue == currentValue)
00152         {
00153             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00154             {
00155                 *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00156                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00157                 --numKrSamples;
00158             }
00159         }
00160         else
00161         {
00162             float valueSlope = (nextValue - currentValue) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00163             
00164             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00165             {
00166                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00167                 currentValue += valueSlope;
00168                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00169                 --numKrSamples;
00170             }
00171             
00172             currentValue = nextValue;
00173         }
00174     }       
00175 }

00178 LLine::LLine(Buffer const& start,   
00179              Buffer const& end,
00180              Buffer const& duration,
00181              const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00182 {
00183     Buffer inputs[] = { start, end, duration };
00184     const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputSizes(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00185     initInternal(numInputChannels);
00186     
00187     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00188     {
00189         internalUGens[i] = new LLineUGenInternal(start.wrapAt(i), 
00190                                                  end.wrapAt(i), 
00191                                                  duration.wrapAt(i), 
00192                                                  doneAction);
00193     }

00196 XLine::XLine(Buffer const& startBuffer, 
00197              Buffer const& endBuffer,
00198              Buffer const& durationBuffer,
00199              const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00200 {   
00201     Buffer inputs[] = { startBuffer, endBuffer, durationBuffer };
00202     const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputSizes(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00203     initInternal(numInputChannels);
00204     
00205     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00206     {       
00207         const float start = startBuffer.wrapAt(i);
00208         const float end = endBuffer.wrapAt(i);
00209         const float duration = durationBuffer.wrapAt(i);
00210         
00211         UGen xline;
00212         
00213         if((start > 0.f && end > 0.f) || (start < 0.f && end < 0.f))
00214         {
00215             // real exponential
00216             Env env = Env(Buffer((double)start, (double)end), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00217             xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction);
00218         }
00219         else
00220         {       
00221             // pseudo exponential where start or end are zero or the line crosses zero
00222             
00223             const float epsilon = 0.0001f;
00224             
00225             if(start < 0.f && end > 0.f) {
00226                 Env env = Env(Buffer((double)epsilon, (double)(end - start + epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential);   
00227                 xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) - (epsilon - start);
00228             }
00229             else if(start > 0.f && end < 0.f) {
00230                 Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start - end + epsilon), (double)epsilon), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential);   
00231                 xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) - (epsilon - end);
00232             }
00233             else if(start == 0.f) {
00234                 if(end > 0.f) {
00235                     Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start + epsilon), (double)(end + epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00236                     xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) - epsilon;
00237                 } else {
00238                     Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start - epsilon), (double)(end - epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00239                     xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) + epsilon;
00240                 }
00241             }
00242             else if(end == 0.f) {
00243                 if(start > 0.f) {
00244                     Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start + epsilon), (double)(end + epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00245                     xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) - epsilon;
00246                 } else {
00247                     Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start - epsilon), (double)(end - epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00248                     xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) + epsilon;
00249                 }
00250             }
00251         }
00252         
00253         internalUGens[i] = new ThruUGenInternal(xline);
00254     }
00255 }

00262 LinenUGenInternal::LinenUGenInternal(const float attackTime, 
00263                                      const float sustainTime, 
00264                                      const float releaseTime, 
00265                                      const float sustainLevel, 
00266                                      const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00267 :   UGenInternal(0),
00268     attackTime_(attackTime), 
00269     sustainTime_(sustainTime), 
00270     releaseTime_(releaseTime),
00271     sustainLevel_(sustainLevel),
00272     currentSegment(AttackSegment),
00273     numSustainSamplesRemaining(sustainTime_ * UGen::getSampleRate()),
00274     currentValue(0.0), 
00275     increment(sustainLevel * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() / attackTime_),
00276     doneAction_(doneAction),
00277     shouldDeleteValue(doneAction_ == UGen::DeleteWhenDone)
00278 {
00279     // assert if duration is negative?
00280 }

00288 void LinenUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00289 {   
00290     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00291     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00292     
00293     // fall through each of these switch..case (purposefully no breaks)
00294     switch (currentSegment) 
00295     {
00296         case AttackSegment:
00297             if(attackTime_ <= 0.f)
00298             {
00299                 currentValue = sustainLevel_;
00300                 if(sustainTime_ <= 0.f)
00301                 {
00302                     if(releaseTime_ <= 0.f)
00303                         currentSegment = EnvDone;
00304                     else
00305                         currentSegment = ReleaseSegment;
00306                 }
00307                 else
00308                     currentSegment = SustainSegment;
00309             }
00310                 
00311             while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == AttackSegment)
00312             {
00313                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00314                 currentValue += increment;
00315                 
00316                 if(currentValue >= sustainLevel_) {
00317                     currentValue = sustainLevel_;
00318                     if(sustainTime_ <= 0.f)
00319                         currentSegment = ReleaseSegment;
00320                     else
00321                         currentSegment = SustainSegment;
00322                 }
00323                 
00324                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00325             }
00326 
00327         case SustainSegment:
00328             while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == SustainSegment)
00329             {
00330                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00331 
00332                 if(--numSustainSamplesRemaining == 0) {
00333                     if(releaseTime_ < 0.f)
00334                         currentSegment = EnvDone;
00335                     else
00336                     {
00337                         currentSegment = ReleaseSegment;
00338                         increment = sustainLevel_ * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() / releaseTime_;
00339                     }
00340                 }
00341                 
00342                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00343             }
00344             
00345         case ReleaseSegment:
00346             while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == ReleaseSegment)
00347             {
00348                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00349                 currentValue -= increment;
00350                 
00351                 if(currentValue <= 0.f) {
00352                     currentValue = 0.f;
00353                     currentSegment = EnvDone;
00354                 }
00355                 
00356                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00357             }
00358             
00359         case EnvDone:
00360         default:
00361             while(numSamplesToProcess) 
00362             {
00363                 *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
00364                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00365                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00366             }
00367             
00368     }
00369     
00370 }

00382 void LinenUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00383 {   
00384     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00385     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00386     double krIncrement = increment * krBlockSize;
00387     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00388     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00389     
00390     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00391     
00392     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00393     {
00394         if(numKrSamples == 0)
00395         {
00396             switch (currentSegment) 
00397             {
00398                 case AttackSegment:
00399                     currentValue += krIncrement;
00400                     if(currentValue >= sustainLevel_)
00401                     {
00402                         currentValue = sustainLevel_;
00403                         currentSegment = SustainSegment;
00404                     }
00405                     break;
00406                 case SustainSegment:
00407                     numSustainSamplesRemaining -= krBlockSize;
00408                     if(numSustainSamplesRemaining <= 0)
00409                     {
00410                         currentSegment = ReleaseSegment;
00411                         increment = sustainLevel_ * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() / releaseTime_;
00412                         krIncrement = increment * krBlockSize;
00413                     }
00414                     break;
00415                 case ReleaseSegment:
00416                     currentValue -= krIncrement;
00417                     if(currentValue <= 0.f)
00418                     {
00419                         currentValue = 0.f;
00420                         currentSegment = EnvDone;
00421                         
00422                         shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00423                     }
00424                     break;
00425                 case EnvDone:
00426                 default:
00427                     currentValue = 0.f;
00428                     break;
00429             }
00430         }
00431         
00432         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00433         blockPosition += numKrSamples;
00434         
00435         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00436         {
00437             *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00438             --numSamplesToProcess;
00439             --numKrSamples;
00440         }
00441     }       
00442 }
